title: Full Stack TypeScript Engineer
targetRole: Full Stack TypeScript Engineer – Next.js & AI (Scale Army)
profile: Full-stack engineer with production TypeScript on both ends of the stack (NestJS backend, React and Vue frontend) and hands-on LLM integration experience: I built the Gemini-powered study feature in Echo, a Flutter app, including schema-constrained generation and a persistent chat session across app restarts. My production frontend work has mostly been Vue/Nuxt rather than Next.js specifically, but the underlying React and App Router concepts transfer directly, and I pick up new frameworks fast. Comfortable with real-time systems (WebSocket, SSE), REST API design, and using AI coding tools (Claude Code) daily while still verifying everything they produce.

education.institution: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology
education.degree: BSc Computer Science with MTN Bright Scholarship Reloaded. First Class Honours

bullets: Led a from-scratch EMR migration from TSOA to NestJS/Prisma with zero data loss, restructuring serialized JSON columns while keeping the API surface backward compatible for existing clients.

2.5+ years progressively owning backend systems for a health-tech platform, from intern to freelance engineer: cloud storage, verification flows, PDF generation, and real-time notifications (SSE, WebSocket) for time-sensitive state changes.
Built low-latency, stateful real-time flows on Node.js (NestJS) end to end, from data model through API to the client-facing notification.

Owned an automated financial computation engine end to end (data model, API, and a Kafka integration publishing finalized data to Amalitech's payroll system), enforcing data integrity via PostgreSQL triggers.
Worked in a team of 4 to build a logging system for aggregating and analyzing logs across services, using Spring Boot on the backend and React on the frontend.

Built and run Orbit, an internal Jira-style project tracker in real daily use by a small dev group: Nuxt 4, Nitro API deployed as Vercel serverless functions, Postgres/Drizzle, with encrypted secrets (AES-256-GCM), audit logging, and TOTP MFA.

Built Orbit's MCP server exposing projects, issues, sprints, and secrets as tools so AI agents interact with it directly, plus a published GitHub Action that pulls a project's secrets from Orbit straight into CI, log-masked, instead of duplicating them into GitHub's own secret store.

Built the Gemini-powered study feature end to end: PDFs uploaded as multimodal content, generation constrained by a structured JSON schema and an anti-hallucination prompt, with chat history persisted locally so context survives app restarts.

Built a browser-based, offline-first Linux desktop simulator in Svelte 5 (window manager, file manager, text editor, terminal, all sharing one virtual filesystem), with a framework-free TypeScript OS shell hosting the Svelte apps mounted per-window and a filesystem persisted to IndexedDB via debounced writes.
